reviewer: A reviewer who has not seen the code

reasons.phone: A red hip roof over a mint upper floor and three dark shops with blank green and orange boards; the stair's stringer crosses the green board. A house with shops on a second look; nothing says laptops.
reasons.silhouette: The hip roof, the tank on its tall stand and the side stair make front, back and both sides a two-storey house with shops below: three of four.
reasons.proportion: The external stair runs diagonally across the front, through two shop openings and their boards, so a person going up would cross the shop doors: one placement visibly wrong. Storeys, windows and the person agree otherwise.
reasons.palette: The roof red and the mint wall read against sand and sky; the worn band is the darker mint.
reasons.wear: Tank on a steel stand, a dish, an AC unit, wires, a generator, goods on the counters.
reasons.variety: Same kit family, and its own: the only hip-roofed shop house of the new set.
reasons.budget: Read from the register row: triangles 928 of 1,500 (61%), draw calls 1 of 1 (100%), materials 1 of 1 (100%), bytes 9,984 of 40,000 (24%). Inside every figure, over 80% on at least one.

notes: Move the stair to the side or behind the bays; letter the boards in the renders. A kit piece: no outline is scored.
